mapper.select: SELECT id, chapter_number AS chapterNumber, title FROM chapters WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY chapter_number
SELECT chapter_id AS chapterId, COUNT(*) AS activityCount, MAX(updated_at) AS lastAt FROM chat_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND chapter_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY chapter_id

SELECT COALESCE(cs.chapter_id_snapshot, s.chapter_id) AS chapterId, COUNT(*) AS activityCount, MAX(cs.updated_at) AS lastAt FROM classroom_sessions cs JOIN classroom_scripts s ON s.id = cs.script_id WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY COALESCE(cs.chapter_id_snapshot, s.chapter_id)
